description: This file defines interfaces, constants, and data structures for cryptographic operations related to Android's hardware identity module, including key generation, signing, verification, and cryptographic context management.

classes.name: EicSha256Ctx
classes.description: Context structure for SHA-256 hashing operations, size defined by EIC_SHA256_CONTEXT_SIZE.

classes.name: EicHmacSha256Ctx
classes.description: Context structure for HMAC SHA-256 operations, size defined by EIC_HMAC_SHA256_CONTEXT_SIZE.

methods.name: eicMemSet
methods.description: Sets a block of memory to a specified value, similar to memset.

methods.name: eicMemCpy
methods.description: Copies a block of memory from source to destination, similar to memcpy.

methods.name: eicStrLen
methods.description: Calculates the length of a null-terminated string.

methods.name: eicCryptoMemCmp
methods.description: Compares two memory regions in a way that is resistant to timing attacks.

methods.name: eicOpsRandom
methods.description: Generates cryptographically secure random bytes.

methods.name: eicOpsGetHardwareBoundKey
methods.description: Retrieves the hardware-bound key if testCredential is true, otherwise returns zeroed key.

methods.name: eicOpsEncryptAes128Gcm
methods.description: Encrypts data using AES-128 GCM mode with associated data.

methods.name: eicOpsDecryptAes128Gcm
methods.description: Decrypts data encrypted with AES-128 GCM mode.

methods.name: eicOpsCreateEcKey
methods.description: Creates an elliptic curve key pair on the P-256 curve.

methods.name: eicOpsCreateCredentialKey
methods.description: Generates a credential key and attestation certificate.

methods.name: eicOpsSignEcKey
methods.description: Generates an X.509 certificate for a public key signed by a specified signing key.

methods.name: eicOpsEcDsa
methods.description: Creates an ECDSA signature over SHA-256 digest using a private key.

methods.name: eicOpsEcdh
methods.description: Performs Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman key exchange.

methods.name: eicOpsHkdf
methods.description: Performs HKDF key derivation.

methods.name: eicOpsSha256Init
methods.description: Initializes SHA-256 hashing context.

methods.name: eicOpsSha256Update
methods.description: Updates SHA-256 hash with data.

methods.name: eicOpsSha256Final
methods.description: Finalizes SHA-256 hash and outputs digest.

methods.name: eicOpsHmacSha256Init
methods.description: Initializes HMAC SHA-256 context with a key.

methods.name: eicOpsHmacSha256Update
methods.description: Updates HMAC SHA-256 with data.

methods.name: eicOpsHmacSha256Final
methods.description: Finalizes HMAC SHA-256 and outputs digest.

methods.name: eicOpsX509GetPublicKey
methods.description: Extracts the public key from an X.509 certificate.

methods.name: eicOpsX509CertSignedByPublicKey
methods.description: Verifies that an X.509 certificate is signed by a given public key.

methods.name: eicOpsEcDsaVerifyWithPublicKey
methods.description: Verifies an ECDSA signature with a public key.

methods.name: eicOpsValidateAuthToken
methods.description: Validates authentication and verification tokens.
